name: sprite2d-shapes
title: Sprite2D: flat shapes (rect, triangle, circle, polygons, outlines) with optional textures, flip, pivot and sorting order, with Lua bindings
issue: Phase E2 of the Triangle-Like plan. Design first: orchestrator/proposals/sprite2d-design.md, decisions A to E in section 4. Code only on the user's go.
acceptance: Sprite2D draws each shape, filled and outlined, with colour, texture region, flip and pivot, on every renderer CI runs; pixel tests on the software renderer
sortingOrder decides draw order, then depth, deterministically
Serializes in scenes and prefabs; Lua can use every field through checked handles
docs/sprite2d.html; web sizes measured, and a 2,000-sprite scene measured
notes: Reviewer: no renderer changes, cull and depth state right for flipped sprites, the software renderer's cut-out path, mesh cache keys, sort determinism.
